fieldData.full-article-text:
Radix uses Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS) to secure the network against Sybil attacks. This is done through users “staking” their tokens by delegating them to validator nodes, which is a form of voting. Token holders receive a reward for staking their tokens.   

Please visit Blockchain & DeFi basics here for details on what a Sybil attack is. 

Please visit the Radix Staking Guide here for details on Radix DPoS staking.
